overview: The City Council approved the FY2027 General Fund Budget after reducing the law department's appropriation by 83% to compel production of detailed litigation records. The Council also established a special education reserve fund, approved several million dollars in free cash appropriations for capital needs and community services, and authorized a formal appeal regarding the city's response to public records requests.

items.title: Resolution Celebrating Marie Cassidy
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Marie Cassidy on her retirement and recognizing her 33 years of service as the director of the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Records and Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved records from June 9 and June 11 and committee reports regarding community safety, resident engagement, and arts funding with minor technical corrections.

items.title: Special Education Reserve Fund
items.summary: Approved the establishment of a Special Education Reserve Fund under state law to manage unanticipated costs resulting from student enrollment shifts and federal funding cuts.

items.title: Free Cash and Retained Earnings Appropriations
items.summary: Approved over $10 million in appropriations to replenish the Capital Stabilization Fund, cover snow and ice deficits, fund police union retroactive pay, and conduct a project labor agreement feasibility study for the new high school.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements and Takings
items.summary: Tabled proposed orders to acquire permanent and temporary easements for the Main Street Corridor project until July 14 because several affected property owners lacked adequate notice.

items.title: Public Records Appeal Regarding Legal Matters
items.summary: Approved an appeal to the Secretary of State's Office regarding the administration's failure to provide comprehensive records of city lawsuits, settlements, and legal expenditures since 2020.

items.title: Affordable Housing and Medford Family Network Funding
items.summary: Approved free cash appropriations of $250,000 for the Affordable Housing Trust and $100,000 for the Medford Family Network to bridge funding gaps.

items.title: CPA and Capital Stabilization Appropriations
items.summary: Approved Community Preservation Act funding for repairs to the Royal House and ADA improvements at Shiloh Baptist Church, as well as capital funds for a needs assessment at Curtis Tufts High School.

items.title: Health and Human Services Personnel Amendments
items.summary: Approved on first reading amendments to the personnel ordinance to rename and reclassify the Director and Assistant Director positions in the Health and Human Services department.

items.title: FY2027 General Fund Budget and Supplemental Appropriations
items.summary: Approved the FY2027 General Fund Budget and supplemental appropriations for library wages and arts programs, while reducing the law department budget by 83% until litigation records are produced. A motion to instead reject the budget in favor of a 1/12th continuing appropriation failed.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel Wage Adjustment
items.summary: Approved on third reading a 2.5% wage adjustment for non-union personnel to align with other city staff increases.
